prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished production concept reference sheet for a handheld collectible prop in a stylized underwater research-station salvage game, X-7. Cohesive chunky industrial sci-fi design, believable manufactured parts, lightly worn enamel metal, rubber seals, restrained transparent glass, broad readable forms suitable for a real-time game. Not photoreal military gear, not ornamental fantasy. Warm light-gray studio background, clear neutral illumination with soft contact shadows, no environment, no people, no hands, no water scene. Landscape sheet: one large detailed three-quarter hero view on the left, two smaller consistent front and side views on the right. The views depict the EXACT SAME OBJECT, with matching proportions, materials, openings and markings. Comfortable margins; all objects fully visible. Small clean English title at upper left, sparse callouts only if helpful; no paragraph text, no logos, no watermark. Strong distant silhouette and reasonable low-complexity modeling. This is a concept sheet, not an actual in-game screenshot.
Title exactly "A — SEALED RESEARCH CORE". Premium grade A sample, 30 cm wide: a compact WIDE SQUAT HEXAGONAL drum with chamfered ivory armor plates, dark graphite rubber end caps, three small amber transparent viewing windows around the central band, gold/amber locking latches, a large embossed A, and TWO short integrated side carry grips. Sealed precision research specimen visible in one window as a compact geometric crystalline-organic core. Hierarchy is precision, robust sealing, valuable payload; not a weapon or explosive. Its silhouette must be hexagonal and squat/wide, very unlike a tall B sample cage or round C jar. Restrained amber indicator strips, simple 3D-printable forms, no spaghetti wires. Show a tiny six-sided silhouette swatch below the title.

Title exactly "MUTATED BLOOM". A UNIQUE quest specimen from an overheated isolation laboratory. A palm-sized fictional marine organism grown into an asymmetric OPEN FLOWER / CORAL ROSETTE: five thick warped petal-like lobes curling around a bright magenta-violet central seed, translucent pale lilac flesh with darker branching veins and a few small pearl-like growths. Beautiful, unsettling and readable rather than bloody or gross. Mounted in a short ivory research transport base with three chunky retaining prongs and a LOW clear splash collar, so the entire irregular organic flower silhouette remains exposed and visible. 28 cm overall height. Subtle localized violet bioluminescence, a small heat-exposure orange warning tab, no grade letter A/B/C. No spikes resembling weapons, no skulls, no generic jar enclosing the silhouette. Include consistent three-quarter, front, side reference views preserving the unique petal arrangement.
